hints.title: Trivial Base Case
hints.text: Dividing a circle into 1 slice requires 0 cuts.

hints.title: Diameter Cuts for Even Slices
hints.text: Each straight line passing through the circle center creates 2 opposite equal sectors. To create n even sectors, n // 2 diametrical cuts suffice.

hints.title: Radial Cuts for Odd Slices
hints.text: For an odd number of sectors n > 1, no cut can pass through to the opposite side to form a symmetrical cut, so exactly n cuts from center to perimeter are needed.

hints.title: Circle Partition Evaluation Implementation

variables: n: desired number of circle slices
complexity.notes: Direct integer parity branching evaluated in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No simulation or geometric iterative methods are required.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that cuts passing through center produce 2 sectors for even n and require n radial cuts for odd n.
